config.commands.templateIconAliases.desc: Alias map used to resolve template command icons. Keys such as `py` can point to packaged icon names such as `python`.
config.commands.languageExecutables.desc: Executable configuration rows. Each row has a command language, an alias selected from the dropdown, and an optional executable file path used when alias is `custom`.
config.commands.languageExecutables.lang: Command language that this executable row applies to.
config.commands.languageExecutables.alia: Use the AnFavorites default executable for this language.
Use the executable path entered in `path`.
config.commands.languageExecutables.path: Program path or command name used when `alias` is `custom`, for example `C:\\Python312\\python.exe` or `/usr/local/bin/python3`.
config.commands.pythonExecutable.descrip: Python executable used when a shell command starts with `python`, `py`, `py3`, `python2`, `python3`, or `pythonw`. Choose `python`, `py`, `py3`, or `custom`.
config.commands.pythonExecutable.enum.cu: Use the custom executable path from Anfavorites > Commands: Python Executable Path.
config.commands.pythonExecutablePath.des: Custom Python executable path used when Anfavorites > Commands: Python Executable is set to `custom`.
config.commands.executableAliases.descri: Executable alias map used before running shell commands. Keys are command executables such as `python`; values can be another alias such as `py` or an absolute executable path.
config.logging.level.description: Minimum log level written to the output channel and files.
config.logging.maxRotatedFiles.descripti: Maximum number of rotated log files to keep.
config.limits.maxPinned.description: Maximum number of pinned favorites allowed.
config.limits.quickOpen.maxFavorites.des: Number of recent favorites to show in Quick Open.
config.limits.quickOpen.maxRecentFiles.d: Number of recently opened files to show in Quick Open.
config.multiroot.separation.description: Allows separating favorites by workspace folder name in multi-root environments.
config.storage.shareAcrossIdes.descripti: Share favorites across IDEs when the workspace is the same (root or multi-root). Saves a file inside the workspace or next to the .code-workspace.
config.search.exclusions.description: Exclusion patterns for file search (node_modules, dist, build, caches, etc.).
config.search.maxSearchFiles.description: Maximum number of files Quick Open can retrieve per search before showing a warning.
config.search.maxSearchResults.descripti: Maximum number of results shown when searching for files in Quick Open.
config.quickOpen.searchCacheSize.descrip: Maximum size of the LRU cache for Quick Open searches.
config.quickOpen.pathDetailLocation.desc: Controls where the file path detail is shown (especially in multi-root).
config.quickOpen.pathDetailLocation.enum: Shows path information after the file name.
Shows path information below the file name.
config.quickOpen.showPathWhen.descriptio: Controls when the file path is shown in Quick Open.
config.quickOpen.showPathWhen.enum.onCon: Only show the path when there are files with the same name.
config.quickOpen.openToSide.description: When enabled, opening a file from Quick Open will open it in the side editor and hide the 'Open to the Side' button.
config.quickOpen.openInNewWindow.descrip: When enabled, opening a file from Quick Open will open it in a new window by default and hide the 'Open in New Window' button.
config.quickOpen.showOpenToSideButton.de: Whether to show the 'Open to the Side' button in Quick Open items.
